title: Sun-Kissed & Luminous: The Bridal Makeup Trends Defining Summer 2026
excerpt: Discover the hottest summer 2026 bridal makeup trends and how to effortlessly incorporate them into your wedding day look.
content:
Summer 2026 is bringing a breathtaking wave of bridal beauty trends that celebrate luminosity, warmth, and effortless elegance. The standout movement this season is the 'glazed skin' aesthetic — a dewy, glass-like complexion that radiates natural radiance without looking overdone. Brides are swapping heavy matte foundations for lightweight, skin-tint hybrids layered with illuminating primers and strategic highlight placement on the cheekbones, brow bone, and cupid's bow. This trend is especially stunning in Fort Lauderdale's golden outdoor light, where the sun naturally amplifies every glowing detail.

For eyes, soft terracotta and warm bronze tones are dominating bridal palettes this summer. These sun-kissed shades complement every skin tone beautifully and pair effortlessly with the season's natural, garden-inspired wedding aesthetics. Think blended rust eyeshadow with a golden inner corner and feathery, brushed-up brows that frame the face without overpowering it. Waterproof formulas are essential for Florida brides navigating heat and humidity while still looking flawless through every emotional moment.

Lip trends this season lean into your natural lip shape with sheer berry stains and peachy nudes that feel wearable yet intentional. Glossy finishes are back in a sophisticated way — think plumped, polished lips that photograph beautifully without stealing focus from your overall bridal glow. At Velora Bella, we tailor every one of these seasonal trends to your unique features, ensuring you feel timelessly beautiful and authentically yourself on your most important day.

title: Old Money Glamour Meets Electric Edge: Palm Beach vs Miami Bridal Beauty
excerpt: Discover how Palm Beach's timeless elegance and Miami's bold vibrancy inspire two entirely different approaches to bridal makeup perfection.
content:
When it comes to Florida weddings, no two destinations tell a more contrasting beauty story than Palm Beach and Miami. Palm Beach brides have long embraced a refined, understated aesthetic rooted in classic elegance. Think soft champagne eyeshadows, perfectly blended rose-nude lips, and luminous skin that photographs like porcelain in golden afternoon light. The venues — think oceanfront estates and historic ballrooms — call for makeup that whispers luxury rather than shouts it. Pearls, lace, and softly swept updos are the hallmarks of a Palm Beach bride, and her makeup follows suit with impeccable precision and restraint.

Miami brides, by contrast, are unapologetically bold. The city's electric energy, vibrant Latin culture, and sultry climate demand makeup that commands attention well into the evening. Deep bronzed skin, dramatic winged liner, vivid coral or berry lips, and glitter-kissed lids are signatures of the Miami bridal look. Rooftop venues, waterfront yacht clubs, and art deco ballrooms set the stage for a bride who wants her beauty to be as unforgettable as the skyline behind her. Sweat-proof, humidity-resistant formulas are non-negotiable in this market.

At Velora Bella, we celebrate both worlds. Whether you are a Palm Beach bride seeking heirloom-worthy elegance or a Miami bride craving high-drama glamour, our Fort Lauderdale studio sits perfectly between these two iconic Florida aesthetics — ready to craft your ideal bridal look with flawless expertise.
